## Deliverable

### Terminology Table

| Preferred term | Synonyms | Broader (genus) | Narrower (species) | Functional description | Terms to avoid | Needs definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| seat ring | seat insert | annular seat member | superelastic seat ring | flexes radially outward to open the purge gap | rubber grommet | yes |
| purge gap | purge clearance | annular clearance | radial purge gap | admits pump air across the surfaces where sealant accumulates | escape hole | no |
| poppet | closure member | movable valve member | conical poppet | seals against the seat ring and carries the purge shoulder | needle | no |
| over-travel | extra stroke | axial displacement | threshold over-travel | poppet movement beyond the normal opening stroke | blow-by | no |

## Rationale

The broader formulation was kept because narrowing to the prototype values would concede scope that the confirmed embodiments support.

## Assumptions

- A1: The bench prototype values are representative.

## Open Questions

- Q1: Is the alloy specification fixed? (blocks P4)
